Referral marketing is the flagship service at a published $5,000/month with a 3-month minimum (updated 2026-09-08 on /referral with service-standard close-the-loop cadence). Campaigns are built on claims-backed referral intelligence covering 48 million+ relationships across 120+ specialties, with multi-channel outreach via fax, email, phone, LinkedIn, and direct mail.
